correctness.rationale: The cited degree-nine base polynomial z^9+z^6+z-1 is irreducible in F5[z] (rechecked independently with finite-field factorization). Nine base points are therefore one Frobenius cycle. On the nine-point blowup, the fiber-orthogonal quotient F^perp/ZF is an E8 root lattice. The paper supplies geometric irreducibility of pencil fibers and identification with the Jacobian elliptic surface of S; translation of section origin acts trivially on generic-fiber Pic^0, giving the essential integral Frobenius-equivariant root lattice isometry. Every root has the unique degree-mod-three normal form d=0 (one +1 and one -1 among m_i), d=1 (three +1), or d=2 (six +1), giving 72+84+84=240. Cycling nine coordinates yields no fixed roots, precisely three three-subset and three six-subset roots fixed by Frobenius cubed, and 234 other roots in nine-cycles. The six exceptional classes have pair-intersection histogram {0:6,2:6,3:3}, and their six disjoint pairs connect in a C6. Geometric descent of unique exceptional representative follows fixed divisor class. Independent exhaustive 240-root orbit and intersection check corroborates these finite steps, not the imported geometric premises.
